titles.title: The Guy I Saw in My Dream Is Amazing!
The Guy of My Dreams Is Amazing!

description:
Gong Mujeong, a 28-year-old civil servant with an MBTI that’s TTTT to the core, suddenly develops a strange ability. Whenever her skin touches someone else’s, she has erotic dreams about that person, a phenomenon known as sex dreams. Things get even more complicated when her friend Kim Namsoon and the younger intern Choi Kang both start making moves on her. Before long, Mujeong unwillingly finds herself having erotic dreams about both of them... On one side is a cute, proper, virginal guy who is pure love personified. On the other is a sexy, smooth-talking younger man with dangerously irresistible charm. Caught between the two, Gong Mujeong struggles to keep her sanity in this wildly chaotic office romantic comedy!
